source.citation: Königsberger, M., Pichler, B., Hellmich, C. (2014). Micromechanics of ITZ-Aggregate Interaction in Concrete Part II: Strength Upscaling. Journal of the American Ceramic Society 97, 543-551.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Sections II-IV, pp. 3-6, read on the page images
transcription.note: Results for the typical concrete of the companion Part I (konigsberger2014stress.json). The text layer of the PDF drops the minus signs of Eqs. (9), (14) and of Bvol - Bdev; they are read on the page images.

Bvol_minus_Bdev.description: Difference of the spherical and deviatoric traction concentration factors on the aggregate surface.

sep_uniaxial_compression.description: Uniaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ-aggregate separation, in units of the separation strength.

sep_uniaxial_tension.description: Uniaxial tensile elastic limit for ITZ-aggregate separation, in units of the separation strength.

theta_tension.description: Zenith angle, in units of pi, where ITZ failure starts under uniaxial tension.

theta_compression.description: Zenith angle, in units of pi, where ITZ failure starts under uniaxial compression.

itz_peak_tension.description: Largest principal ITZ stress per unit uniaxial tensile macrostress.

itz_peak_compression.description: Largest principal ITZ stress per unit uniaxial macrostress, under compression (the stress is positive, the macrostress negative).

itz_uniaxial_tension.description: Uniaxial tensile elastic limit for ITZ failure, in units of the ITZ tensile strength.

itz_uniaxial_compression.description: Uniaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ failure, in units of the ITZ tensile strength.

sep_biaxial_compression.description: Symmetric biaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ-aggregate separation, in units of the separation strength.

itz_biaxial_compression.description: Symmetric biaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ failure, in units of the ITZ tensile strength.
